finding: The two requested-placement endpoints were slower than the default endpoint in this bounded sample. No CF-Placement target was reported, so actual execution in AMS or FRA is not proven. These results provide no reason to change the final default placement.
limits: All twenty-two Worker requests bypassed owner caches and each performed three native R2 GETs and one KV read. Physical storage-service cache state remains unknown.
Every worker_placement event reported entry colo CDG, with no placement header and no target colo. Requested region configuration alone is not evidence of an executed region.
The two regional warmups are separate from their four plain and four hinted measured calls. They warm the client connection/runtime only; owner application caches remain bypassed.
The default group has no extra warm request. Its first call includes a new client connection; the socket setup is recorded. The regional measured groups all reused their warmed sockets.
The target groups run sequentially and use only four selected blocks. Service state and network history can change. No global region ranking or causal account/location claim is made.
The four Helius requests were paired with the default group. They are not a contemporaneous provider pair for each regional request.
Existing held locators and unchanged source objects were used. No new index download, data copy, retry or further data probe was made.
This separate twenty-six-call window does not enter the earlier 109-call platform CPU or cost groups.
